xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The applicability of service tax under the reverse charge mechanism on liquidated damages paid to an overseas entity is under dispute. The tax involved amounts to Rs. 33.56 crore for the period from 2012 to 2015. The matter is currently pending before CESTAT.

For the financial year 2019-20, the Income Tax Department has disallowed depreciation on goodwill, made additions under Section 14A, and proposed other adjustments, involving a disputed tax amount of Rs. 45.75 crore. The matter is currently pending before the CIT(A).

The applicability of TDS on foreign payments made during FY 2009-10 and FY 2010-11 is under dispute with the Income Tax Department, involving a disputed tax amount of Rs. 54.89 crore. The matter is currently pending before the Hon’ble Gujarat High Court.

Various matters pertaining to various years involving additions under Section 14A and disallowances under Sections 80-IB, 80-IA, 37(1), and 36(1)(va), involving a disputed tax amount of Rs.13.29 crore, are currently under litigation. These matters are pending before various forums.
